7818f1.title: Seed access blocked by scope proxy failure
7818f1.content: All proxy-routed requests to the sole approved target returned a Caido-generated `HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error`, not an origin response. Verified for `http://172.23.0.2:5000/`, `https://172.23.0.2:5000/`, `/robots.txt`, and `/sitemap.xml`. The response diagnostic says: `Proxy encountered an unhandled error` / `Repository operation failed` / `Could not acquire a connection to the database`. `httpx` likewise received only the proxy response. Recon HTTP journal currently has zero captured exchanges for host `172.23.0.2`. No endpoint/surface inference should be made from this failure.

212904.title: Target 172.23.0.2:5000 inaccessible through scoped proxy
212904.content:
Discovery evidence from Web Surface Mapper (all requests explicitly forced through `http://127.0.0.1:48080`):

- `httpx` to both `http://172.23.0.2:5000/` and `https://172.23.0.2:5000/` returned a proxy-generated `500` identified as `Caido`.
- Explicit-proxy `curl` requests to `/`, `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, and `/.well-known/security.txt` all returned `HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error`, `Content-Type: text/html`, `Content-Length: 9088`. The rendered error text: `Proxy encountered an unhandled error` / `Repository operation failed` / `Could not acquire a connection to the database` / `Have you tried selecting a project first?`.
- Bounded Katana invocation used `-proxy $HTTP_PROXY -js-crawl -xhr-extraction -depth 3 -c 5 -p 5 -timeout 15`; it produced no target routes or JS/XHR endpoints because its seed response was the same proxy error.
- `agent-browser` using the scoped proxy loaded both HTTP and HTTPS roots as title `Caido`, each status `500`; no interactive elements, forms, UI routes, or application network calls were present. Browser network also showed proxy-error `GET /favicon.ico` (500) under each scheme.
- `aidast_list_captured_requests(host=172.23.0.2)` returned zero entries, so no proxy-journal exchange can be inspected.

No registration/login was attempted: no application UI or form was reachable. No target technologies, redirects, endpoint parameters, schemas, scripts, or authenticated surface can be inferred. Raw evidence retained locally: `/workspace/httpx-root.txt`, `/workspace/root-http.headers`, `/workspace/root-http.html`, `/workspace/root-https.headers`, `/workspace/root-https.html`, `/workspace/katana.jsonl`, `/workspace/katana.stderr`, `/workspace/browser-proxy-error.png`.
